signal: AI is becoming a modular agent stack: longer-running models, model routers, specialized open models, and automated agent evaluation are advancing together.

stories.title: Grok 4.6 targets long-running agents
stories.summary: SpaceXAI released Grok 4.6 on August 12 for long-running agents and complex tasks; MarketWatch also reports the beta launch of Grok Bot autonomous teammates.
stories.whyItMatters: Evaluate models on completed agent tasks, including context handling, recovery, tool reliability, latency and total cost, not only single-call benchmarks.

stories.title: NVIDIA opens Switchyard for model routing
stories.summary: NVIDIA NeMo’s open-source Switchyard translates OpenAI and Anthropic API formats and routes Claude Code, Codex and OpenClaw traffic across local or hosted model backends.
stories.whyItMatters: Routing turns model selection into platform policy, enabling cheaper models for simple stages and stronger models where capability is worth the cost.

stories.title: AEROBAT automates behavioral science on AI agents
stories.summary: AEROBAT generated and tested 79 behavioral hypotheses through 1,240 controlled experiments and 23,512 simulation rounds across 12 target behaviors.
stories.whyItMatters: Behavioral regression testing could become a production discipline for persistent agents, complementing task-success benchmarks with systematic experiments on drift and failure modes.

stories.title: Google reshapes DeepMind around Gemini and recursive self-improvement
stories.summary: Reuters reports that Google’s AI reshuffle emphasizes Gemini, coding performance and research including recursive self-improvement, with Koray Kavukcuoglu taking operational leadership.
stories.whyItMatters: AI-assisted AI development and coding-driven release gates imply faster model turnover, making automated evals, version pinning and controlled rollout increasingly important.

stories.title: NVIDIA expands its open-model stack with Nemotron 3.5 Lightning
stories.summary: NVIDIA released Nemotron 3.5 Lightning for focused agent workloads while Reuters reports that the planned Nemotron 4 family includes a model of at least one trillion parameters.
stories.whyItMatters: Heterogeneous model fleets can pair task-focused models with frontier capacity, using routing and evaluation to decide where expensive capability is actually needed.

takeaway: Build around replaceable model stages, with routing, behavioral evaluation, cost and latency telemetry, versioning and controlled rollout around the model layer.
